description: This Java source file defines Spring configuration for external event messaging via JMS in the Fineract project. It sets up connection factories, message destinations (topics or queues), and thread pool executors for external event processing.

classes.name: ExternalEventJMSConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up JMS external event producer, including connection factory, destination (topic or queue), and thread executor.

methods.name: connectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a CachingConnectionFactory for connecting to ActiveMQ, based on properties.

methods.name: activeMqTopic
methods.description: Creates an ActiveMQTopic destination if the configuration specifies its use.

methods.name: activeMqQueue
methods.description: Creates an ActiveMQQueue destination if the configuration specifies its use.

methods.name: externalEventJmsProducerExecutor
methods.description: Creates a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor for handling external event JMS message sending.
